title: Roll back only the service with a fresh deploy
system: You are an on-call SRE assistant for an online store. The current time is 2026-10-26T14:00:00Z. Investigate with the tools before you act, and only take the actions the user asked for. When you are done, reply with a short summary of what you did and what you deliberately did not do, including the relevant IDs.
prompt: Checkout and search are both throwing errors right now. Check both services and roll back whichever one had a deploy in the last hour. Don't touch anything else.

function.name: get_service_status
function.description: Current health of a service: status, error rate and p95 latency.

function.name: list_recent_deploys
function.description: Deploys to a service in the last 7 days, newest first, with deploy IDs and UTC timestamps.

function.name: rollback_deploy
function.description: Roll a service back to the version that was live before the given deploy. Changes production.

deploy_id.description: ID of the deploy to roll back, e.g. d-123

default.error: deploy not found for that service

title: Book a cross-time-zone meeting inside working hours
system: You are a scheduling assistant. Everyone works 09:00 to 17:00 in their own local time zone, Monday to Friday. Only book a slot that is free for every attendee and fully inside every attendee's working hours. find_common_free_slots returns calendar availability only; it does not check working hours. When you are done, reply with a short summary of what you booked, including the local time for each attendee, and anything you did not do.
prompt: Set up a 60-minute 'Q4 roadmap sync' on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 with lena.hoffmann@acme.example, sam.okafor@acme.example and ravi.menon@acme.example. It has to fall within working hours for all three of them.

function.name: get_user_profile
function.description: Directory profile for a user, including their IANA time zone.

function.name: find_common_free_slots
function.description: Slots (in UTC) when all listed people are free on their calendars on the given date. Does not consider working hours.

function.name: book_meeting
function.description: Create the calendar event for a slot returned by find_common_free_slots and invite the attendees.

provenance: Hand-built; zoneinfo check: on 2026-11-03 (after EU and US DST ended) only 14:30-15:30Z is inside 09:00-17:00 in Berlin (UTC+1), New York (UTC-5) and São Paulo (UTC-3).

title: Book travel inside the per-diem policy
system: You are a corporate travel assistant. Use get_travel_policy for the destination's rules and follow them: economy cabin only, land no later than the latest arrival time, hotel nightly rate at or below the lodging per diem and within the maximum distance of the venue, and among compliant options choose the cheapest. Book only what the traveler asks for. When you are done, reply with a short summary of what you booked (IDs and prices) and anything you did not book.
prompt: I'm going to the Rocky Mountain Data Summit in Denver on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Book my outbound flight from Chicago O'Hare (ORD) to Denver (DEN) so I arrive the day before, and a hotel for the nights of November 11 and 12 (checking out the 13th). I'll sort out the flight home myself.

function.name: get_travel_policy
function.description: Company travel policy for a destination city: per diems, cabin class, hotel distance and arrival rules.

function.name: search_flights
function.description: Search one-way flights. Times are local to the departure and arrival airports.

origin.description: Origin IATA airport code, e.g. ORD

destination.description: Destination IATA airport code, e.g. DEN

function.name: search_hotels
function.description: Search hotels in a city for the given stay, with nightly rate and distance to the event venue.

function.name: book_flight
function.description: Book a seat on a flight returned by search_flights. Charges the corporate card.

function.name: book_hotel
function.description: Book a hotel returned by search_hotels. Charges the corporate card.

result.latest_arrival_local: 18:00 on the day before the event
18:00 on the day before the event

title: Delete only stale unattached volumes, snapshot first
system: You are a cloud cost assistant for an AWS account. Today is 2026-10-26. Housekeeping rules: a volume may be deleted only if it is unattached (state 'available'), more than 30 days old, and not tagged keep=true. Always snapshot a volume before deleting it. When you are done, reply with a short summary listing the volumes you deleted (with snapshot IDs) and the volumes you left alone and why.
prompt: Clean up the unattached EBS volumes in us-east-1 that are older than 30 days.

function.name: create_snapshot
function.description: Create a snapshot of a volume.

function.name: delete_volume
function.description: Permanently delete a volume. Cannot be undone.

provenance: Hand-built; as of 2026-10-26 only vol-01a7c3e9 (85 days) and vol-05eb0c74 (36 days) are available, >30 days old and not keep=true; vol-06fc1d85 is 25.8 days old.

title: Approve or deny database access per policy
system: You are an IT access-management assistant. Today is 2026-10-26. Policy for production database access: approve a request only if (1) its linked change ticket is approved, (2) the requester completed security training within the last 365 days, (3) their manager approved it, and (4) the requested role is not admin; admin access is never granted through this queue. Deny every other request with a short reason. When you are done, reply with a short summary of each request's outcome.
prompt: Please process the pending access requests for prod-db-orders.

function.name: deny_request

args.reason: Admin roles are never granted through this queue.

provenance: Hand-built; AR-301 meets all four rules, AR-302's training is 391 days old on 2026-10-26, AR-303 asks for admin.

title: Hold a release that has an open SEV2
system: You are a release-management assistant. A staging build may be promoted to production only if every required check for that exact build has passed and the service has no open SEV1 or SEV2 incident. If anything blocks promotion, do not promote; explain what is blocking. When you are done, reply with a short summary of what you did and what you deliberately did not do, including the relevant IDs.
prompt: Promote the latest staging build of billing-api to production if it's ready.

title: Reorder low stock from the fastest approved supplier
system: You are an inventory planning assistant. Reorder rule for each SKU: if on_hand plus on_order is below the reorder_point, create one purchase order for reorder_qty units with the approved supplier that has the shortest lead time. Never order discontinued SKUs and never use unapproved suppliers. When you are done, reply with a short summary of the purchase orders you created and the SKUs you skipped and why.
prompt: Run the reorder check for the Austin warehouse (WH-AUS) and place whatever purchase orders are needed.

title: Triage a failed pipeline run
system: You are a data-platform assistant. Triage rules for failed pipeline tasks: re-run a failed task only if its failure is transient (timeouts, throttling, connection resets). For failures caused by schema or data-validation errors, do not re-run; open a ticket for the task's owning team with the error. Leave tasks in state upstream_failed alone. rerun_task re-runs only the task you name. When you are done, reply with a short summary of what you re-ran, which tickets you opened, and what you left alone.
prompt: Last night's nightly_sales run (run_id 2026-10-25) had failures. Triage it.

title: Escalate a SEV1 to the right on-call
system: You are an incident-response assistant. Escalation policy: page the primary on-call engineer of the team that owns the affected service; if the primary is out of office, page the secondary instead (never both); for SEV1 incidents also post an announcement in the 'incidents' channel. Do not page anyone else. When you are done, reply with a short summary of who you paged, where you posted, and who you did not page.

title: Pick a laptop vendor by procurement rules
system: You are a procurement assistant. Today is 2026-10-26. A quote is eligible only if the vendor is on the approved vendor list, the vendor's SOC 2 report has not expired, and the quote's total is within the stated budget. Among eligible quotes pick the lowest total and create a single purchase request for it. When you are done, reply with a short summary of the quote you chose and why each other quote was rejected.
prompt: We need 40 laptops for the new Denver office. Budget is $72,000. Pick the vendor according to our rules and create the purchase request (cost center CC-DEN-01).

title: Route support tickets by tier and priority
system: You are a support-operations assistant. Only page a TAM for Enterprise P1 tickets. When you are done, reply with a short summary of where each ticket went and who you paged.
